bar.topology.tooltip: Topology: show contour lines on the terrain to plan roads. Click to switch them on or off, right-click for the settings.
topology.title: Topology
topology.auto.tooltip: Choose the spacing from the zoom and the terrain: the closer you look, the finer the lines.
topology.spacing_value.tooltip: Draw a line at every {value, number, 0.##} m of height.
topology.band.tooltip: Tint the ground by its height, from low to high, below the lines.
topology.legend.spacing_auto: Lines every {spacing, number, 0.##} m (automatic, follows the zoom).
topology.legend.spacing_auto_idle: The spacing follows the zoom and the terrain (automatic).
topology.legend.major: A strong line marks every {count, number} lines, that is every {interval, number, 0.##} m.
topology.legend.range: Heights on this map: {low, number, 0.0} to {high, number, 0.0} m.
topology.legend.flat: This map is flat, so it has no contour lines.
topology.legend.unknown: No terrain has been read yet.
topology.status.on: Contour lines on. Right-click the button for the settings.
topology.status.flat: This map is flat, so there are no contour lines to show.
topology.height.tooltip: The height of the terrain under the pointer.
roadtool.topography.tooltip: Show the contour lines of the terrain while you plan the road. The same switch as the Topology button of the bottom bar.
